_note: Hand-curated, not touched by scripts/sync.py's automatic hourly sync. Notable centralized and decentralized crypto exchanges that have permanently shut down, been seized/sanctioned, or otherwise ceased operations. Kept for historical reference, not a live feed.

items.name: BitMEX
items.reason: Shut down permanently after an 11-year run; owner HDR Global Trading's board decided to wind down following a strategic review and an unsuccessful year-long sale process, with positions force-liquidated at final closure.

items.name: CoinEx
items.primaryBusiness: Centralized crypto exchange — spot & derivatives trading
items.reason: Announced permanent shutdown on Sept 15, 2026 citing the prolonged crypto market slump and rising compliance costs; halted new user registrations immediately, with withdrawals open and all exchange operations set to fully cease by Dec 22, 2026.
